messages:
alex: deploy-bot alert: canary-usw2 showing p95 token-latency +45%, kv_cache_miss +8%, embedding-sim delta -2.9% for model redwood-v2.4.0
deploy-bot: automated-canary-checker fired at 2024-08-02T14:33Z — trigger: p95_latency > 200ms && sim_delta <= -2.5%. Suggested action: PAUSE rollout; consider pin to v2.3.5 or rollback.
sam: copying metrics. is this only on canary slice or across slices?
maria: only canary-usw2 (12% traffic). no backend errors surfaced. looks correlated with longer-context prompts.
jin: quick check of recent kernel flags and quantization flags — noticed a different matmul kernel was selected for v2.4.0 on Ampere. filing an infra note.
oncall: tagging @sam @maria @tara — what's customer-facing risk? any SLA hits yet?
sam: no 5xx spikes. some interactive customers might see slower responses on long prompts. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~8% which matches the timing.
tara: recommendation: do a targeted canary pin to v2.3.5, run 30m smoke + A/B evals (samples 1k), and pause autopromote for the change window. avoid global rollback unless eval fails badly.
maria: agree. can we patch rollout for canary only? prefer minimal blast radius.
jin: yes. patch command ready:```
redwoodctl rollout patch --slice=canary-usw2 --model=redwood-v2.3.5 --reason "canary latency + quality regression"
```
sam: executing patch now and will notify ops. not posting customer blurb yet unless we widen.
deploy-bot: rollout patch submitted by sam at 2024-08-02T14:39Z. status: pending connection drain.
oncall: watching p95/kv_hit/sim-score dashboards. ping me if anything unexpected.
jin: after pin, p95 dropped ~30% within 6m and kv_hit recovered ~5%. sim delta narrowed to -0.3%. initial sign looks positive.
tara: good. plan: keep canary pinned for 90m, run full smoke-suite and an A/B eval against 1000 sampled prompts across short/medium/long contexts. if stable, resume at 5% increments with the previous kernel selection.
maria: drafting customer blurb in case: "We detected increased latency and reduced similarity for some long-context prompts on the v2.4.0 rollout. We've temporarily pinned a subset of traffic to v2.3.5 while we investigate. No customer errors or data loss observed. Next update in 60 minutes."
sam: will only send to #customer-briefing if we have to expand the rollback. ops note posted to #eng-releases.
jin: kicking off eval: `eval-runner --model-a v2.3.5 --model-b v2.4.0 --samples 1000 --strata short,mid,long --metrics sim,latency,logprob` (started 14:50Z, ETA ~18m).
sam: temporarily disabling autopromote for this change-window:```
deploy-bot config set autopromote.enabled false --until 2024-08-02T16:30Z
```
ton: (bot reaction) :white_check_mark:
tara: once eval results land we'll decide: global rollback to v2.3.5, keep v2.3.5 for longer, or continue with smaller steps + kernel flag revert. consider opening a P2 incident if we widen.
maria: adding a note to release-notes/internal: "Canary pinned to v2.3.5 due to latency/quality regression on v2.4.0; investigating kernel selection and KV behavior; autopromote paused."
sam: summary saved. tagging: managed-manual-pin.
deploy-bot: thread auto-archived after inactivity at 2024-08-02T16:40Z (manual hold still in place).
